item.title: Generative AI has seven distinct roles in combating misinformation
item.description: Reviewed by Ayaz Khan.Generative AI can be used to combat misinformation. However, it can also exacerbate the problem by producing convincing manipulations that are difficult to detect and can quickly be copied and disseminated on a wide scale. item.title: A few weeks of X’s algorithm can make you more right-wing – and it doesn’t wear off quickly
item.description: Timothy Graham, Queensland University of Technology A new study published today in Nature has found that X’s algorithm – the hidden system or “recipe” that governs which posts appear in your feed and in which order – shifts users’ political opinions in a more conservative direction. item.title: Most AI Bots Lack Published Formal Safety and Evaluation Documents, Study Finds
item.description: Story: Fred Lewsey. Reviewed by Ayaz Khan. An investigation into 30 top AI agents finds just four have published formal safety and evaluation documents relating to the actual bots. Many of us now use AI chatbots to plan meals and write emails, AI-enhanced web browsers to book travel and buy tickets, and workplace AI to generate invoices and performance reports.
